day_shape: 90 items: Khamenei issues Sacred Defence Week / Nasrallah anniversary message declaring Hormuz held and predicting no return to 'domination,' Trump signals sanctions-relief-for-nuclear-progress via mediators, rial hits record 2.45m/dollar, IDF completes Mansouri tunnel operation, Kata'ib Hezbollah sets Oct 1 ultimatum on Iran flight ban.

threads.label: Khamenei Sacred Defence Week message
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published the Supreme Leader's message marking Sacred Defence Week and the second anniversary of Hassan Nasrallah's killing, claiming 30 million Iranians pledged self-sacrifice and that the era of foreign 'domination' will not return. Multiple posts framed Hormuz as held by Iran and cast Lebanese figures aligned with the West as doomed.

threads.label: US-Iran mediated talks and sanctions offer
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump is willing to offer sanctions relief and release of frozen funds in exchange for concrete nuclear progress, with Qatari mediators expected to hold separate US and Iranian talks alongside FM Araghchi. Trump told reporters the US would win its 'war' with Iran 'very soon'; a regime source told Press TV reports of Iranian nuclear flexibility were false.

threads.label: Hormuz control and CENTCOM rebuttal
threads.summary: CENTCOM publicly rejected an IRGC commander's claim that Iran controls the Strait of Hormuz, saying over 1 billion barrels of oil have transited freely and that US forces sank Iran's navy. IRIB carried Rear Admiral Sayyari saying Iran can strike US carriers and that American vessels 'fled' to the south Indian Ocean; USS George Washington was shown conducting flight ops in the Arabian Sea.

threads.label: Iran flight bans and Najaf route
threads.summary: Iraqi PM efforts and reported US consideration of a sanctions waiver for pilgrim flights coincided with announcements that Iran-Najaf flights would resume, while Kata'ib Hezbollah set an Oct 1 ultimatum threatening border closures if the air blockade on Iran continues. Iran International reported Iran's shrinking international air links are raising costs and straining regional ties; protests were staged at Najaf airport.

threads.label: IDF operations in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF announced completion of a large-scale operation in Mansouri, saying troops dismantled 600+ Hezbollah infrastructure sites, seven underground routes and a tunnel found in a civilian home. Separately, troops fired on two suspects entering the buffer zone and launched an interceptor at a suspicious aerial target over the operating area.

threads.label: Iranian economy and domestic politics
threads.summary: Iran International reported the rial hit a record low of 2.45 million to the dollar under economic and military pressure, and that hardline MP Hamid Rasaei was jailed for 10 months over a complaint by Speaker Ghalibaf. A parliament deputy speaker said a triple-urgency bill on NPT withdrawal is under review, and Fars accused reformists of feeding Trump's pressure campaign.

threads.label: Araghchi UNGA sideline diplomacy
threads.summary: IRIB posted readouts of FM Araghchi meeting Sri Lankan and Malian counterparts and the head of the International Elders group on the margins of the 81st UN General Assembly. Araghchi told the Elders that insecurity in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz was the result of outside interference and urged adherence to the UN Charter.

events.title: The Israeli military says it has completed a large-scale operation to destroy Hezbollah infrastructure in the southern Lebanon town of Mansouri.
